meaning:
ἀ-κατά-γνωστος, -ον
(καταγινώσκω), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:47 ;]
not open to just rebuke, irreprehensible: Tit.2:8 (see Cremer, 676; and for other exx., MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.
